programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Titanic: A Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: As the Titanic started to sink in April 1912, another ship came into view, offering her passengers the hope of being rescued. However, despite a fusillade of rockets, the ship turned away. Within two hours, 1,500 people were dead. An American investigation at the time accused the SS Californian, even though the freighter was stationary that night. A British inquiry concurred, keen to shift blame from national failures on lifeboat provision and steamship supervision. However, since Titanic's wreck was discovered, the mystery began to unlock, and now, with recently discovered clues, a new suspect has emerged: the SS Mount Temple. This documentary follows a range of experts, using the latest investigative tools, as they examine these new clues and revisit the evidence from 1912 to take a fresh look at the cold case of the 20th century.

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Ancient Cities and Enduring CreaturesUnexpected things revealed by catastrophic disasters, featuring a submerged funerary complex in Greece, ancient mammal footprints preserved by a Turkish volcanic eruption and North American fossils from the post-dinosaur era.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S3 E3 — North NorfolkTony Robinson travels along the north Norfolk coast through one of the least developed spots in Britain, finding out how the area maintained its rural, remote identity despite the dynamic industrial changes of the Victorian age. From the arrival of Bertie, Prince of Wales at Sandringham House to the opening of Cromer Pier, Tony's four-day walk sees him learn about key periods in the county's history. He explores prime shooting estates, purpose-built seaside resorts, salt marshes and disused railway lines as he discovers how powerful landowners were able to control development and even shape the railways to suit their needs.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Brontë CountryTony Robinson embarks on another expedition through some of Britain's most historic landscapes. The moors and valleys of West Yorkshire were the home of, and inspiration for, the Brontës, the literary family who produced such classics as Wuthering Heights and Jane Eyre. Over four days, Tony heads out from the Victorian wool capital of Bradford and treks in a giant loop around what is now known as Brontë Country. From the birth of Charlotte, Emily, Anne and their brother Branwell in the suburb of Thornton, he traces their childhoods to the much-romanticised Brontë hub of Haworth, finding that the harsh reality of life in the 1820s was far removed from the fantasy world dreamed up by the children at their father's parsonage home.

Plus, antiques expert Simon Schneider tries to buy a pair of spelter warriors.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: The US military oversees the repopulation of Britain after a virus that turned those infected into bloodthirsty killers finally dies out. Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programme.desc: The wise-cracking mercenary teams up with the resurrected X-Men veteran to take on a lethal adversary. Superhero sequel, starring Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin and Matthew Macfadyen.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: A teen arrives in an isolated community of youngsters, with no memory of who he is or the outside world. When another new arrival brings an ominous message, he realises time is running out for the group and they must find an escape route through a deadly labyrinth if they are to survive. Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: While scavenging items from a derelict space station, a group of young colonisers fight for survival when they cross paths with lethal life forms. Co-writer/director Fede Alvarez's horror sequel set between the events of Alien and Aliens, starring Cailee Spaeny, David Jonsson and Isabela Merced.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: Forky Asks A Question
programme.desc: What Is Time?Rex uses the age of dinosaurs as an example to give Forky an understanding of the concept of time.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Pocahontas
programme.desc: A Native American princess falls in love with an English settler, but her father is distrustful of the Europeans - not without just cause, as a cruel governor is prepared to wage war to get his hands on the gold he believes they are hiding. Animated drama, with the voices of Irene Bedard, Mel Gibson and Christian Bale.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: A wizard living secretly in modern-day New York vows to prevent his mystical enemy from taking over the city. Realising that he is unable to complete the task alone, he recruits an ordinary teenager to be his assistant, teaching him to master the magical arts. Fantasy adventure, starring Nicolas Cage, Jay Baruchel and Alfred Molina.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Taken prisoner by a victorious king, he is sent out to destroy the leader of the barbaric cult that destroyed his village and slaughtered his family. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol 2
programme.desc: After saving Xandar from Ronan's wrath, intergalactic outlaws Peter Quill (AKA Star-Lord), Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, Groot and Rocket Raccoon are recognised as heroes. Now, they must fight to stay together as they unravel the mystery surrounding Ego, a man who claims to be Quill's father. Writer/director James Gunn's follow up to his 2014 blockbuster, which reunites Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Karen Gillan and Dave Bautista, with support from Kurt Russell, Sylvester Stallone and Pom Klementieff. Bradley Cooper also provides the voice of Rocket and Vin Diesel is Groot.

programme.title: Aliens Vs Predator - Requiem
programme.desc: A spaceship crash results in the infestation of a small town by aliens, so a Predator is despatched to hunt them down - and any superfluous humans who happen to get in the way. However, an even bigger threat is lurking in the area, in the form of a terrifying hybrid of the two extraterrestrial creatures. Sci-fi action sequel, starring Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth and John Ortiz.

programme.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. To his surprise, she is flattered by the gesture, but her ex-boyfriend is furious and they are soon forced to spend a night fleeing for their lives together. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

The last hope to stop the destruction is an unlikely group of people united by fate and unimaginable circumstances.

programme.desc: Jack Burton agrees to pick up a friend's girlfriend from the airport, but when Miao Yin is kidnapped in front of him, Burton finds she's been abducted by sorcerer Lo Pan, the host of the spirit of an ancient Chinese warlord. He wants her for her unique green eyes, rare among Chinese women, that will rejuvenate his spirit and Burton has just hours to track down his lair and free Yin.

programme.title: Ready or Not

There's just one catch - she must now hide from midnight until dawn while her new in-laws hunt her down with guns, crossbows and other weapons. As Grace desperately tries to survive the night, she soon finds a way to turn the tables on her not-so-lovable relatives.

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Suffolk and NaplesRick starts by celebrating the abundance of seafood and rich, colourful sauces of Naples. He visits Suffolk for North Sea cod with beer, bacon and cabbage, and takes a trip on the Thames to eat fresh brown shrimp.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: S1 E2 — India and CornwallRick Stein travels to Goa, where he prepares prawn caldine and spicy Goan lobster. Closer to home, he catches turbot off the Cornish coast and cooks it with cider and cream in his newly refurbished kitchen.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Spain and BritainRick Stein travels to Galicia in Spain to attend the collection and festival of percebes, or goose barnacles, and creates dishes using hake and clams. Returning to Britain, he sings the praises of the humble cockle.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: S1 E4 — India and AmericaRick Stein discovers spicy shark vindaloo and dhal with lentils in Goa, and freshwater oysters in crab cakes in America's Chesapeake Bay. In Cornwall, Rick prepares nasi goreng with mackerel.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Australia and ItalyRick Stein's seafood odyssey continues in Queensland, where he learns the tricks of seafood cooking Australian-style. Back at home in Padstow, he prepares seared tuna with vegetables from his garden.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: S1 E6 — America and CornwallRick Stein goes fishing in Chesapeake Bay, Maryland, and pan-fries the large striped bass he caught. He then moves on to Bowens Island in South Carolina, where he realises his dream of indulging in oysters at a seafood shack. In Thailand, Rick prepares a traditional soup called tom yum goong, with squid and crunchy green vegetables.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Thailand and CornwallRick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand where he spends time in local markets, talking to locals about various types of food. In Cornwall, he fries up fish and spices it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice. Rick also cooks up a dish inspired by a dream described by the programme's director, poached fish balls with tagliatelle.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: S1 E8 — America and YorkshireRick Stein meets up with an old friend in America, where he fries soft-shell crabs and grills lobsters. Singapore chilli crab is on the menu in Padstow, while his seafood odyssey ends in Whitby with fish and chips.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Ruth DavidsonPrue cooks a Colombian dish inspired by her love for travelling and invites former Scottish Conservative leader Ruth Davidson to cook a classic childhood dessert.

programme.desc: S15 E12 — Pubs and GrubA classic British pub cooks gourmet grilled cheese and porchetta, a brewing station serves shrimp and grits with craft-made beers, and a corner spot serves pasta loaded with littleneck clams.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S26 E4 — Swiss, Sandwiches and SausageGuy samples grilled cheese sandwiches with a twist, made-from-scratch sausages and specialities straight out of Switzerland.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S26 E12 — Turkey, Taters and DogsGuy digs into a righteous mashup of flavours across the country, including a potato-centric palace dishing out hearty Brazilian specialities and a dynamite deli serving up real-deal latkes and turkey pastrami.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S26 E13 — Burgers, Beef and BarbecueGuy dives into beef and barbecue in Florida and California, including an authentic Vietnamese spot serving up phenomenal pho and a smokin' barbecue joint where they're even putting their 'cue into lasagna.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S26 E9 — Goin' InternationalGuy Fieri grabs gangster global grub from a Jamaican joint in Houston and a 24-hour burrito hot spot in Cancun, Mexico.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S15 E7 — Flavortown MedleyThis trip, Guy's diggin' into all kinds of fantastic flavours. In Memphis, there's a bar-turned bistro offering low brow favourites like duck fried rice and Jack Daniel's bread pudding.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S15 E9 — HandcraftedGuy's checking in on tasty joints run by food fanatics. In Memphis, he visits the chef-slash-farmer running a farm-to-table spot serving up a whole lot of classics from meatloaf to sloppy joes to catfish.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S26 E1 — Belly Up to BarcelonaGuy Fieri crosses the Atlantic to dive into the many different cuisines of Barcelona, Spain. Here he samples Galician-style octopus and soup, traditional sausage and old-school Catalan cooking.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Long IslandAdam Richman eats his way around America. Adam heads to Port Royal Grille in New York state and attempts the Davy Jones' Locker Challenge.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E10 — Kansas CityAdam Richman eats his way around America. Adam attempts the Ultimate Destroyer Challenge at Papa Bob's Bar-B-Que in Kansas City.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E12 — Jersey ShoreAdam Richman eats his way around America. He attempts the Ludicrous Wings challenge: that means guzzling 12 super spicy hot wings in fifteen minutes or less.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: Portland, METhe ever-hungry Adam Richman chomps his way across America. In Portland, he attempts the Manimal Challenge in which he must eat a 4lb meal in 20 minutes or less.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E16 — ButteAdam Richman chomps his way across America. He takes on the Jumbolie Challenge, attempting to eat a five pound Stromboli in less than an hour.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Oklahoma CityAdam Richman eats his way around America. Adam takes on the Fried Catfish Challenge, attempting to eat 29 catfish fillets.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E11 — IndianapolisAdam Richman eats his way around America. This time, he attempts the Big Ugly Burger Challenge at Bub's Burger Ice Cream in Indianapolis.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E13 — SyracuseAdam Richman eats his way around America. In Syracuse, he takes on the Frittata Challenge, a breakfast mountain weighing in at over 6-lbs.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E15 — Niagara FallsAdam Richman eats his way across America. He heads to Niagara Falls for an Italian food challenge involving 10 plates and 7lb worth of food in 90 minutes.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S3 E17 — SacramentoAdam Richman travels across the United States to find the country's best traditional food, while undertaking tough eating challenges along the way.

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
programme.desc: S1 E19 — Isle of SkyeJames takes a trip to the stunning Isle of Skye, where he's joined by top chef and ultimate Scotsman Tony Singh. Tony visits a local bakery, which doubles as an art gallery, and learns to make the local oatcakes. James is inspired by the amazing local seafood, and cooks up a tasty dish using plaice and lovage. Their day comes to a perfect end aboard a boat, where they spot dozens of dolphins, and James cooks up a fresh lobster and langoustine dish with an added Scottish twist.

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
programme.desc: S1 E20 — ShetlandJames visits a place he's always wanted to see: the beautiful Shetland Islands. James hires a vintage car to explore the area, where he learns about traditional fish salting and cooks a tasty vegetable curry at a local social enterprise project.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S12 E1 — Cake WeekNoel Fielding and Matt Lucas lead 12 new bakers in a brand-new bubble through a series of new challenges set by judges Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith, in the nation's most famous tent.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S12 E2 — Biscuit WeekFor Biscuit Week, the bakers take on filled brandy snaps for the signature. They produce a jammy childhood favourite in the Technical and finally put their engineering skills to the test to create an interactive toy made exclusively from biscuit.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S12 E3 — Bread WeekThis week it's time to bake bread, and the remaining bakers have a lot to prove. They put their own twist on a classic Italian focaccia in the Signature and head slightly further east in the technical, making a Greek-inspired snack.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S12 E4 — Dessert WeekIt's Dessert Week, and the bakers put their twist on the classic pavlova, take on a toffee technical, and create a delicate dessert wrapped in intricately patterned sponge for the showstopper.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Football
programme.desc: S1 E1 — West HamAdam explores the football food culture of East London and West Ham United at the London Stadium. He joins fans of the club, called Hammers, for pie and mash and tries prawn curry.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Football
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Notts ForestAdam goes to Nottingham to watch Notts Forest. He heads into town to try a bowl of ramen, then orders a fan favourite, the 'pizza dog'.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Football
programme.desc: S1 E3 — ChelseaAdam is in West London to watch Chelsea FC. Matchday starts with a doorstep bread breakfast sarnie, before trying a posh scotch egg and a tasty kebab.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Football
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Episode 4Adam Richman is in Birmingham for an Aston Villa home game. He gets to tuck into an Indian mixed grill at a 'Desi Pub', tries a Champions League standard mushroom ravioli and enjoys a pad Thai at a Villa fans' match day favourite: The Barton Arms.

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: S1 E1Michel reveals his recipe for poached cod with orange and vermouth. Later, he uses leftover croissants and brioches to make a tasty dessert.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraJames is shown how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, visits a local brewery and sees Iberian pigs while also cooking dishes that include a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth ll's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: London and South East Mains and Desserts
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: North East Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the topspot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, `Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by Grime Music called `Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called `My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multi-part venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned `St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, `No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred `Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes and she's using Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Joe has sourced his ingredients locally too, using hay from his family farm and Jersey beef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Tom `Westy' Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant `The Classroom' in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheriden formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish `The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist DonnaTaggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland will recreate their four course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There's also a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland will recreate their four course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There's also a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu

As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worth of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs must cook in an unfamiliar kitchen and scale up their dishes to provide the highest calibre of dining for a full banquet room of diners. Their guests are celebrities and unsung heroes who have helped create British music's unparalleled global reputation.

The feast will honour the hopes and achievements of the country's sporting heroes, and it will be a glorious celebration of Britain's culinary talents. Great British Menu veteran Jeremy Lee will decide who goes through to the judges.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: Tony's walk takes him back to 1940 when the sleepy county of Dorset became the frontline in the war against Hitler. programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: Tony Robinson goes for a walk through some of Britain's beautiful and historic landscapes. Tony kicks off the series with a 40-mile walk through the glorious Peak District, along the Derwent Valley, where the world's industrial revolution was born. This is a journey that reveals how Britain transformed itself from a nation of farmers into the industrial powerhouse of the world.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: Tony Robinson hikes 45 miles through the Weald in Kent and the Downs of East Sussex to discover the area's rich and surprising Tudor heritage. At the impressively preserved Penshurst Place, author Philippa Gregory helps Tony relish the fate of the Grand Duke of Buckingham at the hands of the young Henry VIII. Tony finishes in Lewes, where he relives one of the more brutal monastic dissolutions.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: In the final episode of the series Tony takes on a tough four-day trek through the Kintail region of the west Scottish Highlands to discover the story of the Jacobite uprisings of the early 1700s. programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E43 — Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
programme.desc: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Paraguay v FranceParaguay v France (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the second round-of-16 match, which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. The South Americans caused an upset in the last round, providing a defensive masterclass to edge past Germany in a dramatic penalty shootout, following a 1-1 draw. They'll need a similarly heroic display here against France, who are the tournament favourites, bang in form and awash with attacking talent.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraThe chef discovers how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, and visits a local brewery. He also creates a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S2 E2 — North AmericanAinsley Harriott delves into the tastes and flavours of North America, making his own version of a famous fast food chain's double burger, as well as peanut butter and jelly brownies. He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E16 — NormandyThe chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Oscar-winning spy adventure starring Sean Connery, Claudine Auger and Adolfo Celi. A Nato aircraft has been stolen by criminal organisation Spectre and the world is threatened by its nuclear payload. Agent 007 is assigned to the case and the trail leads to the Bahamas and the sinister Emilio Largo.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: E52 — 05/07/2026A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S7 E7Alan is joined by star of Gavin & Stacey Joanna Page, sports presenter and host of The High Performance Podcast Jake Humphrey, and India Hicks. Farmer Tom Davis brings along a pair of piglets to hog the limelight, and drinks expert Andy Clarke shares his favourite tipples inspired by the movies in the Best of British feature.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Ellie SimmondsPrue welcomes Ellie Simmonds back for a second visit to her kitchen after the two got on so well the first time, with the five-time Paralympic swimming gold medallist baking a coffee and walnut cake. Prue's food hero is a tea producer from the Vale of Glamorgan who makes loose leaf tea and kombucha tea, while he has a versatile baked feta, roasted tomatoes and garlic dish on the menu and is pleased when a hack for egg yolks goes well.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: S10 E8 — EssexAlan Titchmarsh and his team of gardening experts head to Waltham Abbey in Essex to create a tropical escape with a yoga deck and home office at its heart for Venessa Taylor, a selfless leukaemia survivor who campaigns to raise the awareness of blood cancer and the importance of bone marrow donations across all ethnic groups.

programme.desc: E52 — 05/07/2026 - 1Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: S20 E2 — Death of the Small CoppersThe headmaster of a local school is murdered, his body found pinned to the wall in the manner of his own butterfly collection. The dead man was a member of a mysterious international club for geniuses, which are currently testing the school's pupils for possible new recruits. Barnaby and Winter investigate the secretive organisation, which has proven controversial in the local area, but also uncover the possibility of a connection between the killing and the impact of pesticides on a rare species of butterfly.

programme.title: You Only Live Twice
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Sean Connery and Donald Pleasence. When international crime syndicate Spectre captures an American spaceship in the hope of starting the Third World War, James Bond is dispatched to Japan to face arch villain Blofeld, the man behind the evil scheme.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S16 E100Bradley Walsh presents as Nathan from Hitchin, Olivia originally from Guernsey, Michaela from Lincolnshire and Martyn from London pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Brazil v NorwayBrazil v Norway (Kick-off 9.00pm). Coverage of the third round-of-16 match, which takes place at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Brazil came from behind to beat Japan 2-1 in injury-time, having trailed at the break, with goals by Casemiro and Gabriel Martinelli breaking Japanese hearts. Despite not quite reaching their peak yet, Brazil will start as favourites here as they look to move a step closer towards a first World Cup triumph since 2002. Norway had Erling Braut Haaland to thank for a late winner in their last-32 match against Ivory Coast, after Amad Diallo's stunning goal had seemed enough to take the game into extra time.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E43 — Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Paraguay v FranceParaguay v France (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the second round-of-16 match, which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. The South Americans caused an upset in the last round, providing a defensive masterclass to edge past Germany in a dramatic penalty shootout, following a 1-1 draw. They'll need a similarly heroic display here against France, who are the tournament favourites, bang in form and awash with attacking talent.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E43 — Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: Paraguay v FranceParaguay v France (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the second round-of-16 match, which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. The South Americans caused an upset in the last round, providing a defensive masterclass to edge past Germany in a dramatic penalty shootout, following a 1-1 draw. They'll need a similarly heroic display here against France, who are the tournament favourites, bang in form and awash with attacking talent.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraThe chef discovers how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, and visits a local brewery. He also creates a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S2 E2 — North AmericanAinsley Harriott delves into the tastes and flavours of North America, making his own version of a famous fast food chain's double burger, as well as peanut butter and jelly brownies. He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E16 — NormandyThe chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Oscar-winning spy adventure starring Sean Connery, Claudine Auger and Adolfo Celi. A Nato aircraft has been stolen by criminal organisation Spectre and the world is threatened by its nuclear payload. Agent 007 is assigned to the case and the trail leads to the Bahamas and the sinister Emilio Largo.

Barnaby and Winter investigate the secretive organisation, which has proven controversial in the local area, but also uncover the possibility of a connection between the killing and the impact of pesticides on a rare species of butterfly.

programme.desc: Brazil v NorwayBrazil v Norway (Kick-off 9.00pm). Coverage of the third round-of-16 match, which takes place at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. programme.title: Attenborough and the Giant Elephant
programme.desc: Naturalist David Attenborough investigates the life of Jumbo, a famous Victorian elephant, supposedly the largest that ever lived. Jumbo arrived at London Zoo in 1865 and was popular with the royal family, but was dangerously unhappy in captivity. In later life, he would be sold to PT Barnum's circus, becoming a celebrity before dying under mysterious circumstances. Attenborough examines Jumbo's remains and considers the lives of elephants in the wild to learn more about the animal's difficult life

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A further selection of creepy-crawly close-ups, focusing on courtship in the bug world. Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough shifts the focus to bugs that prefer co-operation rather than conflict. They include burrowing cockroaches, the suitably named social spiders - which share a 30-metre web - the queen bee and her happy hive of workers and green ants pulling together to build a nest

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his close-up examination of the creepy-crawly world, shifting focus to the bugs' ultimate invention - the colony. Key residents of these minuscule mega-cities include honey bees, termites, leafcutter ants - who have a knack for farming - and their Argentine cousins, members of a community so vast it spans an entire continent

programme.title: Hello Kitty: Super Style!
